info.title: Zoonotify Public Data API
info.description:
Read-only, anonymous access to the zoonoses surveillance data published on
[Zoonotify](https://zoonotify.bfr.berlin), plus the reference vocabularies needed to
interpret it. No authentication is required.

Only the collections, fields and query parameters described here are supported.
Anything else the server happens to answer is unsupported and may change or disappear
without notice.

The API is versioned independently of the Zoonotify site. A new major version may
break existing scripts; minor versions only add.

Most collections hold records in English (`en`, the default) and German (`de`); pick one
with the `locale` parameter. The same `documentId` names a record in both languages.
Collections without a `locale` parameter exist in one language only.

tags.name: Surveillance data
tags.description: Prevalence and antimicrobial-resistance results from German zoonoses monitoring.

tags.name: Reference vocabularies

documentId.name: documentId
documentId.description: The record's `documentId`, as returned by the list operation.

filters.name: filters
filters.description: Narrow the results, e.g. `filters[samplingYear][$eq]=2022` or `filters[microorganism][name][$eq]=Salmonella spp.`. See [Strapi's filter operators](https://docs.strapi.io/cms/api/rest/filters). An unknown field or operator returns 400.

sort.name: sort
sort.description: Sort by one or more attributes, each optionally suffixed with `:asc` or `:desc`. Repeat the parameter for several. An unknown attribute returns 400.

paginationPageSize.name: pagination[pageSize]
paginationPageSize.description: Records per page. Larger values are silently capped at 8000; non-numeric values are ignored.

locale.name: locale
locale.description: Language of the records. One `documentId` names the same record in both locales. A locale other than these returns an empty list rather than an error.

BadRequest.description: Invalid query parameter, e.g. an unknown field in `filters`, `sort`, `fields` or `populate`.

NotFound.description: No record with this `documentId` in the requested locale.

ServerError.description: Server error. Retry later, and report it if it persists.

documentId.description: Stable id; the same `documentId` names this record in every locale.
